newsitem.title: USA: Total System expects to exceed projections.
newsitem.headline: Total System expects to exceed projections.

text.p: Total System Services Inc's Chairman and Chief Executive Richard Ussery said Monday he expects the company's earnings this year to exceed current analysts' estimates by about 10 percent.
The company said it expected higher revenues based on a grwoth in existing customers' accounts on file and increased volumes.
The projection also includes better-than-anticipated results for the start up of Vital Processing Services LLC, a merchant-processing joint venture with Visa U.S.A., Total System said.
The merger of the two companies' merchant-processing operations was completed in May.
Analysts esimates were not immediately available, and a company spokesman did not immediately return a telephone call seeking the information.
Total System is a credit, debit and private-label card processing companies.
